<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Employee or department"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Submit IT solution request" sourceRef="Participant_Requester" targetRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="Assess and implement IT solution request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_IT">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssessRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Procure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Install</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RollOut</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_KeepSupportAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Completed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="IT solution request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestToAssessment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Request" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess request">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check compatibility with existing systems and evaluate cost and resource needs.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestToAssessment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssessmentToApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssessmentToApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcureToInstall</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcureToInstall</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InstallToTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test solution in controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InstallToTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestToResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Testing successful?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestToResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestSuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestUnsuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RollOut" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestSuccessful</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RollOutToTrainingChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training" name="Provide training?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RollOutToTrainingChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingProvided</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingSkipped</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingProvided</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Continue after training choice" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingSkipped</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingMergeToSupport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_KeepSupportAvailable" name="Keep IT support available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingMergeToSupport</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SupportToCompleted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Solution rolled out; IT support available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SupportToCompleted</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful" name="Testing unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestUnsuccessful</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToAssessment" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentToApproval" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_Procure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">requestApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not requestApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcureToInstall" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InstallToTest" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestToResult" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestSuccessful" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RollOut">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testingSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestUnsuccessful" name="Unsuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not testingSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RollOutToTrainingChoice" sourceRef="Task_RollOut" targetRef="Gateway_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingProvided" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">trainingProvided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingSkipped" name="No training" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not trainingProvided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMergeToSupport" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_KeepSupportAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SupportToCompleted" sourceRef="Task_KeepSupportAvailable" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
